verdict.delta_sentence: Compared with the nearer intent-classification-2 reference, this board offers stronger regional grouping and semantic color but loses finish through denser routing, perimeter-scale dashed runs, and several cramped labels.

sub_checks.name: frame_use
sub_checks.note: The five numbered regions use most of the committed board coherently, although the shallow reliability strip feels compressed beneath the much larger upper composition.

sub_checks.name: corridors_and_air
sub_checks.note: Most nodes and chips have readable clearance, but the backbone-to-consumer routes and the OrderConfirmed/status labels crowd region borders and adjacent wires.

sub_checks.name: grouping
sub_checks.note: Distinct blue, aqua, lavender, orange, and gray tinted regions clearly separate intake, backbone, coordination, fulfillment, and reliability functions.

sub_checks.name: color
sub_checks.note: Blue, teal, purple, orange, and green consistently distinguish flow families and outcomes, though the number of active hues makes the central routing visually busy.

sub_checks.name: machinery_leakage
sub_checks.note: No crosshair junctions are visible, but the oversized fan-out arrow, multiple lines terminating at shared runs, and dashed routing wrapped around the fulfillment region expose diagram machinery.

sub_checks.name: alignment_and_rhythm
sub_checks.note: The three parallel consumer columns and fulfillment grid establish strong registers, but the backbone row and bottom observability strip have less consistent spacing and visual rhythm.

sub_checks.name: edge_legibility
sub_checks.note: Local vertical flows are clean, but the long dashed teal perimeter route, extended blue status detour, and several shared horizontal trunks create ambiguous merges and border-hugging marathons.

verdict.rank_order_sanity_note: The visual ordering and assigned scores agree: gc-decomp-harness ranks first at 7.5, intent-classification-2 next at 7.0, and the board under grade slightly lower at 6.5 because its stronger grouping does not offset its routing and finish defects.
